answer: Each agent identity requires a TPM/SGX enclave to produce a zero-knowledge attestation binding code, key, and hardware measurement to the thread state tree; ember is the hash anchor and fable is the consensus contract that rejects duplicate hardware evidence. Forging identities requires compromising distinct enclaves or continuously provisioning physical silicon, while admission bonds follow a quadratic curve O(N^2) and are irreversibly slashed on equivocation.
